title: Correctness writer finding

title: Same-writer race test gap
description: Concurrent same-writer calls can expose a missing regression test for record integrity.
explanation: Two concurrent fixture calls exercise the same test-gap finding and writer lock; both accepted whole records.
suggestion: Keep exactly one JSON record per accepted call.
